name: Self-Destruct
effect: Recharge. If you are Revived, you must still spend your next turn Recharging. After the damage is dealt the User faints. Add 1 Damage for every 20% of missing HP the user has, rounded up. This damage only applies to Foes. You can use `/calculate_hp_damage_modifier` to calculate this for you. Inflicts Wounds.
description: The pokemon makes use of its ability to blow up parts of its own body in an impressive display of power.
